name: Summer Track & Field
description_short: A summer youth track and field program run by Auburn Recreation for ages 6-14. It has two practices and one meet (on Thursdays) each week at the ELHS track.
refund_policy_summary: You get a full refund if you withdraw 3 or more business days before the first class, and 50% if you withdraw with less notice. You can also get 50% back if you are unhappy after the first class and tell them before the second class. There are no refunds after the second class. If Auburn Recreation cancels, all fees are refunded. A participant who can't continue because of an injury can ask for a pro-rated refund. There are no cash refunds, and refunds take 14-21 days.
special_needs_notes: Auburn Recreation provides reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities. You must ask at least 10 days before the program's first day.
